div.div: لَمَاظٌ A thing which one tastes, (K, TA), and with which one moves about the tongue in the mouth. (TA.) You say, مَا لَهُ لَمَاظٌ He has not anything to taste, (K, TA,) &c. (TA.) And مَا ذُقْتُ لَمَاظًا I have not tasted anything. (S) And شَرِبَ المَآءَ لَمَاظًا He tasted the water with the extremity of his tongue. (S, M, K. *) [See also what next follows.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
